## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Header | icon + app name + time | application_id / source, created_at |  | GtkImage + labels + badge |
| Title & body | text | title, body | full text | GtkLabel |
| Open | primary-button | action_url | Hub route → navigate in-app; https → open in browser / installed app (Universal/App Link); private scheme → hand to OS; hidden when null | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |
| Contextual actions | buttons | by category | security.new_sign_in → "Review sessions" (ACC-04) · security.password_changed / email_changed / mfa_disabled / session_reuse_detected → "Secure my account" (ACC-04) · account.organization_invitation → Accept / Decline (ORG-09) · account.access_granted → Open app (APP-03) | GtkButton |
| Delivery | disclosure | push.status, devices_targeted/sent/failed, skip_reason, deliveries[] (30 days) | plain-language: "Pushed to 2 devices", "Not pushed — notifications are off for this app" | AdwExpanderRow |
| Mark unread / Archive | toolbar | PATCH {state} |  | AdwHeaderBar buttons |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Opened | `PATCH /users/me/notifications/{notificationId} {state:read}` | on open if unread |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/me/notifications/{notificationId}`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
